name: Hightouch Marketing Agent
description: Hightouch's AI marketing agent. Builds and saves audiences and journeys, and answers marketing analytics and strategy questions over your customer data.

extensions.description: Uses A2UI cards for interactive responses.

skills.name: Audience creation
skills.description: Create and iterate on customer audience definitions from natural language.
examples: Create an audience of users who made a purchase in the last 30 days

skills.name: Journey creation
examples: When a user signs up, wait 1 day, then send a welcome email

skills.name: Marketing analytics
skills.description: Answer marketing analytics and strategy questions over warehouse data.
examples: How did the spring campaign perform last month?
